articles.title: Strategy sold another $105 million of bitcoin last week, repurchased $81.2 million of STRC
articles.snippet: The company trimmed bitcoin holdings by 1,638 coins, while raising $290.6 million with sales of common stock.

articles.title: Robinhood wins UK crypto registration before new regulatory regime kicks off
articles.snippet: Robinhood’s U.K. arm was added to the FCA's list of registered cryptoasset companies as of July 31.

articles.title: Trump Media’s bitcoin stash may be down to loan collateral after $165 million BTC move
articles.snippet: Wallets tied to the Truth Social parent now hold about as much bitcoin as the company previously pledged as note collateral, making its next 10-Q the key test of whether recent Crypto.com transfers were custody moves or sales.

articles.title: Michael Saylor’s Strategy is now tracking bitcoin’s 200-week moving average
articles.snippet: Michael Saylor’s company, Strategy, is now closely monitoring bitcoin’s 200-week moving average, a key long-term support level that the cryptocurrency has historically respected.

articles.title: The future of crypto payments won't include on-ramps or bridges, Fun CEO says
articles.snippet: Alex Fine said standalone crypto payment rails are becoming obsolete as platforms shift toward unified funding flows that abstract away blockchain complexity for users.
